text: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR FISCAL RESPONSIBILITY AND BUDGET MANAGEMENT ACT, 2006 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200612 Act Number: 12 Enactment Date: 2006-08-09 Act Year: 2006 Short Title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR FISCAL RESPONSIBILITY AND BUDGET MANAGEMENT ACT, 2006 Long Title: An Act to provide for the responsibility of the Government to ensure prudence in fiscal management and fiscal stability by progressive strengthening of revenue surplus, reduction in fiscal deficit, prudent debt management consistent with fiscal sustainability, greater transparency in fiscal operations of the Government and conduct of fiscal policy in a medium term framework and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
